customers_say: Customers find the water purifier delivers quality water that tastes great and is easy to maintain, with professional installation service included. They appreciate its reliability, appearance, and consider it a budget-friendly option, with one customer noting its premium matte finish. However, several customers report issues with water leakage from the unit.

reviews.author: Nikhil Shiv
reviews.title: Excellent Product and Service
reviews.body: Great product with excellent service. The water tastes much better, and the installation process was easy. Happy with my purchase and would recommend it.

reviews.author: Vivek Gupta
reviews.title: Good product
reviews.body: Product is good and installation process was also nice. Recommended especially for senior citizens where you don't need touch buttons etc

reviews.author: PREETAM N.
reviews.title: Marvellous-M0
reviews.body: Just a word.... "Marvellous". The purifier is first of its kind. It's look, finesse, performance, everything is perfect. I installed the one in my office. Now after few months of usage I m thinking of changing my home water purifier to the M0 from urban company.

reviews.author: Gaurav
reviews.title: Good product, can go for it...
reviews.body: I was looking for a RO for my home and came to know about native RO on urban company app. After some research on Google and watching some youtube videos i finalized this product and waited for the Amazon sale. Now it's about an month I am using this RO and based on that I list some of its pros and cons. Pros: 1. Delivery by Amazon and installation service by UC was fantastic, no complains about that.
